Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1189
Claimant:
Lisa Pacheco
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
February 18, 2023
The claimant reported a side impact at an intersection and a wrist fracture from the collision. The injury description fits
the kind of force a side impact of this type would produce.
February 20, 2023
The police report places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene, and the responding officer's notes are consistent
with the account given at first contact.
February 27, 2023
Two independent witnesses and the other driver each described the collision the same way the claimant did. Scene
photographs were also received and reviewed.
April 9, 2023
The damage to the claimant's vehicle lines up with the described impact point and direction. No earlier damage to the
vehicle has come to light in our review.
May 17, 2023
The claimant has given the same account in each conversation so far, with no changes in sequence or detail. The
driver is named on the policy, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
June 5, 2023
Meidcal records show the claimant was receiving treatment for the same wrist and arm condition well before this
collision. Most of the current complaints appear to trace back to that earlier condition.
June 15, 2023
Treatment has grown to many times the usual course for this type of fracture, with near-daily visits. Several weeks
after the collision, new body areas were added to the claim without a clear link to the crash mechanics.
September 25, 2023
The file has been referred for a medical review of the pre-existing records and the treatment timeline. Settlement
discussions are on hold until that review is complete.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
